significance: Heinrich Institoris (Kramer), co-author of the forthcoming Malleus Maleficarum, was expelled from Innsbruck by the Bishop of Brixen after his attempted witch trials were derailed by institutional resistance and by a panel of theologians who found his procedures irregular. The Malleus, published two years later, was partly a response to this failure.
source_method: Innsbruck diocesan records; analyzed in Hutton, The Witch (2017); Ankarloo and Clark Vol. 3 (2002)
